profile.headline: Sr Programmer Analyst at Advocate Program, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in the design and development of object-oriented applications using C-Sharp, VB-Net, Oracle, SQL Server and ASP. Enhanced and maintained systems using structured analysis and design methodologies.
 Assurant’s Licensing System – This is a windows forms application written in C-Sharp with an Oracle database. The Assurant’s proprietary library (Framework) of classes was used consistently to communicate with the database. 
The application has a user-base of 40 across multiple sites in the United States, is the key enterprise system that keeps client information and processes their licenses and appointments in order to allow for the sale of insurance products within state regulations. 
 Assurant’s Business Disruption System – Customization and implementation of the Business Disruption system. This is an intranet application used to communicate any business disruption within the organization. This is an ASP web application using SQL server as main unit of data storage.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Design and development of ASP.Net applications written in C# using SQL server, SQL server Reporting Services, crystal report and Web services.
